note: musl native libraries. The bridge detects a musl-libc Linux JVM (Alpine) from /proc/self/maps (override: -Dvespera.native.libc=musl|glibc) and loads native/linux-<arch>-musl/ first, falling back to the glibc native/linux-<arch>/ library with a WARN only when no musl build is bundled; glibc JVMs are unchanged. Gradle plugin: *-linux-musl* target triples are bundled under native/linux-<arch>-musl/ (also when the targets key is the plain linux-<arch>), linux-<arch>-musl keys are accepted, and a musl build host bundles its host build under the -musl folder.
